name: restaurant-marketplace
description: Adnan Qasim's Restaurant Studio — a Claude Code plugin that renders mouthwatering culinary food cards, menu spotlights, and sizzling video reels scored with music for Zaiqa Lounge & Grill. One brief, three canvases (square, portrait, story), all rendered locally via Remotion.

plugins.name: restaurant-studio
plugins.description: Render mouthwatering restaurant food cards (dish spotlight, chef special, flash deal, customer review, story announcement) and sizzling video reels with music — warm flame orange on charcoal wood, Inter typography. Ultra-HD stills at 4x, reels at 2x, all local via Remotion.
